system.description:
Starting at 18th level, your contract with the Reaper reaches its zenith, twisting your Fuin-curses into a conduit of absolute control. You can now have up to two creatures marked with Curse of the Reaper at the same time. Both marked creatures share the same Hex effect. Cursing a third creature removes the effect from the one with the oldest duration.

Also, as a Bonus Action, you may shift a hex currently applied to all creatures affected by Curse of the Reaper or Gravetouched, replacing it with a different hex of your choice. You may swap Hexes in this way once per turn.

Finally, you gain the final Hex taught directly from the Reaper and his progeny, Reapers Hex.

Reapers Hex. A creature marked with the Reapers hex is marked for death and doom. Any time they would regain hit points or chakra or gain temporary hit points or temporary chakra; you instead regain it in their place. Additionally, when they are reduced to 0 hit points or chakra points, it erupts in a burst of necrotic chakra. All enemies within 15-feet of the erupting creature must make a Charisma saving throw, taking 6d6 necrotic and chakra damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. Regardless of a success of failure, all allied creatures within 15-feet of the erupting creature is bathed in rejuvenating energies, regaining 4d6 hit points.
